note: The clause package is the dense timed fixture plus the places, anchors, frames, parameters, constraints, resets, guard and invariant that CL-01 lists; every clause is listed by the root and every reference is joined. The two clock-bearing operations are arm(c: Clock), touch(i: Integer) and size(); a clause refers to an operation by the operation_anchor node of its declaring model with no execution point (FR-342-AC-11). The selected document also declares the entity Gadget with one operation, ping(), only so that CL-25 can name an anchor of another model; no other clause names it.

clock_constraint.bound: a quantity literal of the root's unit node, nonnegative, in lowest terms

clock_reset.value: a quantity literal of the root's unit node, nonnegative, in lowest terms

clock_guard.part: binding predicate, then one reference to a clock_constraint for each constraint of the part, in order; a part names at least one constraint and a guard at least one part

time_invariant.bounds: a nonempty aggregate of references to clock_constraint nodes of kind place whose comparison is lt or le

membership: derived clause-side: a clock_guard, clock_reset, time_invariant or clock_constraint listed by no root aggregate is not a member of the model (a guard that exists is listed, FR-322-AC-243); a clock_constraint is a member through the guard part or invariant that names it, and the root lists every constraint that a part or an invariant names, and no other

quantified_out_of_scope.note: Producer-level cases: they are source text and the refusal a producer gives, not package patches, because no package is emitted for them. excluded_forms.note: Producer-level cases, like QN-01 and QN-02: source text and the refusal the checked-package producer gives, not package patches, because no package is emitted for a refused form. Each refused form is excluded from the checked package by rule: the producer refuses unsupported_construct/expression-form at the form, naming the construct, writes no clause node for the operation and does not approximate the form. The `built` cases are controls: the form is built, and the package row that pins it is named. The package rows CL-20, CL-55 and CL-56 pin the reader side of the same exclusions (a part with no constraint, a reset with no value, a reset with no slot term for a collection place). Test tc_367_excluded_clause_forms_are_published pins the codes, the causes and that FR-322-AC-267, FR-415-AC-25 and TC-367 CK-38 name them; no reader or producer in this repository executes them (the producer is quire-spec-language, QSL).

cases.note: a presence requirement is a postcondition predicate, a presence_read expression, and not a write: the package carries no clause node for it. With the precondition establishing absence the producer refuses invalid_timed_model/clock-presence-unwritten (FP-11); otherwise the requirement restricts the pre-state to a present v (FP-09)
